name: glass-controls
description: A framework-free control layer of glass: live backdrop refraction for surfaces, magnifying lenses for sliders and segmented controls, and spring touch physics. Lenses by liquid-glass-js.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --format=esm --external:liquid-glass-js --outfile=dist/glass-controls.js && esbuild src/index.js --bundle --minify --format=esm --external:liquid-glass-js --outfile=dist/glass-controls.min.js && cp src/glass-controls.css src/glass-controls.d.ts dist/

author: Thomas Kramer
